payload.default: Nothing prevents it by design: ledger is append-only, events 8-12 stay visible as history. Job row's current_seq field determines worker's view; worker rebuilds from ledger 1-7 only. If seq 8-12 reference git commits or rundir state, those are orphaned but harmless—operator owns cleanup if needed.
payload.text: What prevents wind-back from creating an inconsistent state where the job row points to seq 7 but the ledger has events 8-12 that reference objects or state that would be unreachable after the rewind?
